players.name: Jonathan Kuminga
players.note: Kuminga (shoulder) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 106-98 win over Portland and did not return. He closed with 13 points (5-12 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), nine rebounds and one assist across 29 minutes.

players.name: Jaylen Clark
players.note: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

players.name: Chris Youngblood
players.note: Youngblood (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.

players.name: Vít Krejčí
players.note: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Ja Morant
players.note: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

players.name: Anthony Edwards
players.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
